The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:prescription_error: Prescriptions and e-prescribing problems always go to a human. Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.

{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Ticket:
Apologies for reaching out - token authentication failing during controlled substance setup

Hello, I am so sorry to bother you with this, but I am having some trouble finishing up my controlled substance prescribing setup. I completed my identity verification steps earlier, but now every time I try to use my authentication token to sign a test script, the system gives me an error code and won't let me finalize it. I have tried restarting my browser and re-entering the token code several times, but it keeps failing. Could you please point me in the right direction so I can get this sorted out? Thanks so much.
